sample_unit: orthopaedic conditions (each queried with 2 templated questions, before and after priming)

links.outcome: Share of LLM patient education responses at appropriate reading level (consensus of 8 readability tests)
links.effect: ChatGPT-3.5 produced 2% (upper) and 4% (lower extremity) of responses at appropriate level vs 54% for ChatGPT-4.0 for both; after priming, 0% vs 64%.
links.quote: ChatGPT-3.5 produced only 2% and 4% of responses at the appropriate reading level for upper- and lower-extremity conditions, respectively, compared with 54% produced by ChatGPT-4.0 for both upper- and lower-extremity conditions (both P < .0001).

unlisted_practices: Priming prompts to lower the reading level of LLM-generated patient education materials

screen.reason: Evaluated the readability of ChatGPT-3.5 and 4.0 patient education materials before and after a priming phase intended to constrain reading level.
